excerpt: To extract neutrino properties, long-baseline experiments need an accurate determination of neutrino cross sections within their detector(s). Since very few of the needed neutrino cross sections across the energy spectrum are directly measured, we emphasize the need for theoretical input.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); A. B. Balantekin, S. Gardiner, K. Mahn, T. Mohayai et al. (17 authors)
title: Snowmass Neutrino Frontier: Neutrino Interaction Cross Sections (NF06) Topical Group Report
